fullContentHtml:
MPPSC Assistant Professor Online Form 2025 – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the notification for the post of Lecturers in various subjects (Group-B). This recruitment has been issued for 1930 posts. Online applying process for MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025 has started from 07 February 2025 & the candidates can apply till 26 March 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 February 2025
  • Last Date : 26 March 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 March 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PH : Rs. 250/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Official Website

MPPSC Assistant Professor Online Form 2025 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
